_comment: GENERATED by tools/lines/gen_book_index.py from the route files and rows. Do not edit by hand.

abyssal_black_flame.name: Abyssal Black Flame
abyssal_black_flame.book_name: Grimoire of the Black Flame Dragon
abyssal_black_flame.desc: A cold, dark fire that burns what ordinary flames cannot. Wrap a fist in black flame, roll it across the ground, or let it bloom into a dragon of ash.
abyssal_black_flame.book_lore: It does not warm, it does not light, and it never goes out.

aether_bow.name: Aether Bow Mastery
aether_bow.desc: An archer's line of arrows made of mana: piercing shots, seeker volleys and arrows that mark, pin and rain from above. A ranged line for patient hunters.
aether_bow.book_lore: The string sings what the heart already decided.

aether_destruction.name: Aether Arts: Destruction
aether_destruction.desc: Aether in its most unforgiving aspect. Lances, collapses and cleaves that do not stop at armor, for a fighter who ends fights fast and pays in guard.

aether_step.name: Aether Step
aether_step.desc: Aether used to cross distance: step through a heartbeat, vanish from where the blow lands and appear behind the foe. The line of speed, afterimages and the single decisive strike.
aether_step.book_lore: It is not speed. It is not being where they expected.

aevum_hourglass.name: Aevum: Hourglass of Ages
aevum_hourglass.desc: A time-bending art of the Aevum: sand that slows the foe, shortens the fight and stretches the moments you need. Slow-and-wait control with a sudden fall of years.
aevum_hourglass.book_lore: Every grain is a second someone else will not get.

aggro_manipulation.name: Threat Table Mastery
aggro_manipulation.desc: Read and bend the hidden threat table of every monster so the whole room hits the armor and nothing else. A tank's discipline: hold attention, soak it, hand it back.
aggro_manipulation.book_lore: Every number on the threat table is a leash, and he holds all the ends.

airiel_wind_maiden.name: Airiel: Wind Maiden
airiel_wind_maiden.desc: A sword wrapped in a gale: dashes, crescents and a descent from the sky, all carried by a wind that never leaves the blade. The Sword Princess's way.
airiel_wind_maiden.book_lore: The wind is a good friend, and quiet about it.

ais_sword_princess.name: Ais, the Sword Princess
ais_sword_princess.desc: The Loki Familia's Sword Princess: a wind barrier that sharpens every step, a storm that answers her chant, a blade that never wastes a stroke and a toll the wind collects later. Evolves after eight hundred kills.
ais_sword_princess.book_lore: She has never said what she is chasing. The wind around her says it for her, and it says it very fast.

amazon_berserker.name: Amazon Berserker
amazon_berserker.book_name: War Songs of the Amazon Tribe
amazon_berserker.desc: Fight like the warrior-women of the Amazons: huge swings, a rage that feeds on its own wounds and a charge that does not care who is in the way.
amazon_berserker.book_lore: Fear is a thing other people have.

animation_cancel.name: Animation Cancel Technique
animation_cancel.book_name: Frame Data of the Skipped Heartbeat
animation_cancel.desc: Skip the recovery of every move: end a lunge halfway, step out of a swing, chain the next one before the last has landed. Frames are the only currency.
animation_cancel.book_lore: Nothing is slow if you refuse to finish it.

anti_magic_blade_dancer.name: Anti-Magic Blade Dancer
anti_magic_blade_dancer.desc: No spells, no grimoire: a sword that eats magic and a body that never stops moving. Cut the incoming spell in half, rush through the gap and keep swinging.
anti_magic_blade_dancer.book_lore: A thin book bound in black cloth with a single instruction on every page: swing.

argonaut_charge.name: Argonaut
argonaut_charge.desc: The Skill that rewards daring: charge the strike, loose it all at once and hit the thing everyone else ran from.
argonaut_charge.book_lore: You do not need to be strong. You need to be about to be.

asura_ascension.name: Asura Ascension
asura_ascension.desc: The bloodline of the gods of Epheotus. A towering, almost unkillable fighter who stands where a mountain would fall, crushes with pressure and lands like a falling sky.
asura_ascension.book_lore: They did not come to Dicathen to be gentle.

baran_demon_monarch.name: Baran, Monarch of Demons
baran_demon_monarch.book_name: Chronicle of the Demon Castle's King
baran_demon_monarch.desc: The king of the Demon Castle: lightning that tears the air, a charge in white flame, a legion that pours from hell-portals and a hunger that feeds on blood. Evolves after eighty thousand damage dealt.
baran_demon_monarch.book_lore: He does not ask the weak to kneel. He waits, and the castle does the asking.

basic_swordsmanship.name: Basic Swordsmanship
basic_swordsmanship.desc: The first skill every sword-bearer learns, in the same series: a plain, honest blade skill. Strikes, steps, a crescent cut and the habit of answering a blow with a better one.
basic_swordsmanship.book_lore: A thin practice manual, thumbed soft. Nothing in it is a secret; all of it is true.

beast_communion.name: Beast Communion
beast_communion.book_name: Whisper Book of the Beast Child
beast_communion.desc: A boy who can talk to animals leads a pack. Howl to rally it, charge as one, and let the wild take care of its own.
beast_communion.book_lore: The animals never lied to him, and in a world of stories that was worth more than anything.

beast_monarch.name: Monarch of Beasts
beast_monarch.desc: Lead the pack as the apex of every wild thing: pounces, rending claws and a howl that lifts the whole party.
beast_monarch.book_lore: Every pack is a family. This one has fangs.

beast_will.name: Beast Will
beast_will.desc: Instinct from a beast's will, grafted onto a human fighter. The line feels for prey, pounces, rends and grows more dangerous with every kill.
beast_will.book_lore: It is hunger. It is also loyalty. Learn the difference.

beastkin_lord_carrion.name: Carrion's Beast Transformation
beastkin_lord_carrion.book_name: Hunt Songs of the Beast Lord
beastkin_lord_carrion.desc: A beastman's war form: bounding, clawing, crushing. The body becomes a lion or a wolf for a time, and fights as one does when the hunt is on.
beastkin_lord_carrion.book_lore: He wore a man's face for politeness.

bell_firebolt.name: Bell's Firebolt
bell_firebolt.desc: Chantless fire magic fired as fast as the next breath: streams of bolts, a charged lance and the nerve to keep running straight at the monster.
bell_firebolt.book_lore: No incantation. Just a very strong opinion.

beru_ant_king.name: Beru, the Ant King
beru_ant_king.desc: The insect marshal's savage grace: leaping pounces, mandible rushes and regeneration that makes him all but unkillable. Feral, fast and hungry.
beru_ant_king.book_lore: Loyalty is the only thing harder than his shell.

beta_tester_insight.name: Beta Tester's Insight
beta_tester_insight.book_name: Patch Notes of the Old Version
beta_tester_insight.desc: He knows the early versions: where the item is hidden, which patch broke the boss. His knowledge reads the world like a sheet of notes, and every note is a target.
beta_tester_insight.book_lore: The bug was fixed in the update. He had not updated.

black_bulls_vanguard.name: Black Bulls Vanguard
black_bulls_vanguard.desc: The reckless frontliner of a squad of misfits: draw the whole battlefield onto yourself, laugh at the damage and hit back twice as hard. Strength through spite.
black_bulls_vanguard.book_lore: A battered log from a squad hideout that is half battle plan, half bar tab.

black_heavenly_demon_sword.name: Black Heavenly Demon Sword
black_heavenly_demon_sword.book_name: Manual of the Black Heavenly Edge
black_heavenly_demon_sword.desc: A merciless sword style soaked in demonic qi. Every cut is a crescent of black light that drinks a little of whatever it touches.
black_heavenly_demon_sword.book_lore: No sect taught it; it was taught by the dead who had tried to survive.

bloodlust_pressure.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust_pressure.desc: Let your killing intent leak out and the weak simply stop: stunned, nauseous and frozen in place while the strong remember fear.
bloodlust_pressure.book_lore: The first hunter to flinch has already lost.

blue_rose_cavalier.name: Blue Rose Cavalier
blue_rose_cavalier.desc: A disciplined knight of a rose-bearing order: all grace and thorn. You bind foes in frozen vines, break them with a lance of petals and hold the line with a smile.
blue_rose_cavalier.book_lore: A knight-captain's code of honour, bound in cornflower-blue silk.

boar_warrior_might.name: Boar Warrior's Might
boar_warrior_might.desc: The strongest warrior of the strongest familia: earth-shaking waves, a stampede nobody stops and a hand that picks monsters up and throws them. Inspired by the boar-man champion of the story.
boar_warrior_might.book_lore: He has never needed to be told twice. He has rarely needed to be told once.

bonded_beast.name: Bonded Beast: Sylv's Wing
bonded_beast.desc: A fighter and a bonded dragon-beast who share one fight. The line is a support brawler's: heal, rally, strike together, and always keep the partner within reach.

bookmark.name: Bookmark
bookmark.desc: A ribbon laid between the pages of the world. Mark your place, skip ahead, and snap back to wherever you left the story.
bookmark.book_lore: The reader keeps his place in a thousand worlds with a single red thread.

borg_barrier_adept.name: Borg Barrier Adept
borg_barrier_adept.desc: The art of the unseen wall: a thin glowing field that turns blades, spells and even bad intentions. You are very hard to hurt and annoying to be near.
borg_barrier_adept.book_lore: A schoolbook that deflected an apprentice's fireball and kept its dust jacket.

boss_pattern_reader.name: Boss Pattern Reader
boss_pattern_reader.book_name: Strategy Guide of the Third Phase
boss_pattern_reader.desc: Every boss repeats itself. Mark the pattern, step out of the telegraphed hit, and strike during the opening. Takes patience, rewards the thorough.
boss_pattern_reader.book_lore: On the fourth attempt he stopped dying.

braver_command.name: Braver's Command
braver_command.desc: Lead the line from the front with a spear, a plan and a very good eye for weak points. A tactician-warrior line of marks, rallying calls and thrown spears. Inspired by the pallum captain of the story.
braver_command.book_lore: Courage is a method, not a mood.

breaking_the_sky_sword.name: Breaking the Sky Sword
breaking_the_sky_sword.desc: A sword that is swung at the heavens. One cut opens a seam in the cloud, and what stands beneath it learns what 'heavy' means.
breaking_the_sky_sword.book_lore: The sky is only the biggest thing a sword has not yet cut.

cauldron_witch_alchemist.name: Cauldron Witch Alchemist
cauldron_witch_alchemist.desc: A witch of vials and steam: heal with a tonic, harm with a flask, and lace everything with a little too much dragon's-breath. Prepared for any fight if you had a minute to brew.
cauldron_witch_alchemist.book_lore: Splattered with ink and something green; the margins are full of 'DO NOT DRINK'.

cha_hae_in_sword.name: Cha Hae-In's Sword
cha_hae_in_sword.desc: The S-rank sword hunter who smells mana the way others hear a voice: she reads her prey before it moves, marks the weak point and finishes it with a single thrust. Evolves after thirty elite kills.
cha_hae_in_sword.book_lore: She smells the fight before she sees it, and she has never once been wrong about who is lying.

character_list.name: Character List
character_list.desc: A roster of personas that you can put on like costumes. Equip the Vanguard, then the Assassin, and play every part the scenario needs.
character_list.book_lore: Each name on the list is a life you have read, and any of them can answer when you call.

cheese_strategy.name: Cheese Strategy
cheese_strategy.desc: The monsters' AI has holes and he knows each of them: blind them, leash them to a corner, snipe from where they cannot reach. Not honorable, extremely effective.
cheese_strategy.book_lore: Every boss has a spot where it cannot reach you.

cinder_ella.name: Cinder Ella
cinder_ella.desc: Magic that changes your face until midnight: borrowed identities, blurred outlines and a mirror dress that sends blows back where they came from.
cinder_ella.book_lore: All the magic ends at midnight. Everything else you did stays done.

constellation_patronage.name: Constellation's Patronage
constellation_patronage.desc: A distant star takes an interest in you. Blessings, coins and well-timed gifts rain down while the audience watches and cheers.
constellation_patronage.book_lore: Every coin is a vote, and every vote is a star leaning closer to watch.

consumable_optimization.name: Consumable Optimization
consumable_optimization.desc: Potions are not a panic button but a resource: pre-buff, time the heal, share the surplus. A knight with a full belt is a knight who does not fall.
consumable_optimization.book_lore: Seventeen potions, and not one of them drunk too late.

coral_peacock_trickster.name: Coral Peacock Trickster
coral_peacock_trickster.desc: A flamboyant illusionist of smoke and mirrors: you are never where the foe's eyes say. Dazzle them, scramble their senses and leave them swinging at your feather-bright afterimage.
coral_peacock_trickster.book_lore: A courtly manual written in three different handwritings, two of them illusions.

core_refinement.name: Mana Core Refinement
core_refinement.desc: The long road from a black core to a silver one. Absorb mana, refine it, and spend it in bursts of pressure; a patient line that grows stronger the longer you meditate.
core_refinement.book_lore: A black core becomes silver one breath at a time.

crimson_lion_blazeguard.name: Crimson Lion Blazeguard
crimson_lion_blazeguard.desc: A noble knight of a house of flame: proud, scorching and shielding the people at your back. Every battle is an exhibition of lion-hearted heat.
crimson_lion_blazeguard.book_lore: A noble house's drill book: how to burn brightly without burning your friends.

crimson_sovereign.name: Crimson Sovereign's Pressure
crimson_sovereign.book_name: Court Manual of the Crimson Throne
crimson_sovereign.desc: An ancient demon lord whose presence alone halts armies. The line is built around dominance: stillness in the room, a blow that ends a fight, no sweat at all.
crimson_sovereign.book_lore: He did not rise to meet them. They fell to their knees instead.

crozzo_magic_sword.name: Crozzo's Magic Sword
crozzo_magic_sword.book_name: Forging Notes on a Sword That Burns Out
crozzo_magic_sword.desc: A smith's gamble: a sword that fires real flame with every swing and shatters when the fire is spent. Overload for tremendous damage, then hold the shard.
crozzo_magic_sword.book_lore: A weapon that lasts forever is a weapon that was never really used.

cursed_equipment_mastery.name: Cursed Equipment Mastery
cursed_equipment_mastery.desc: Gear everyone else leaves behind: heavy curses for huge numbers. The knight wears the penalty like a medal, and so long as he stays alive it pays for itself in blood.
cursed_equipment_mastery.book_lore: Its price is written on the label. He paid it.

damage_rotation.name: Damage Rotation Priority
damage_rotation.desc: A perfectly practiced opener, then a loop of attacks in the exact order that does the most damage. Interrupt him and the rotation stops; leave him alone and the numbers climb.
damage_rotation.book_lore: Skill one, skill three, skill two, repeat. Do not miss.

dark_rukh_fallen_magi.name: Dark Rukh Fallen Magi
dark_rukh_fallen_magi.desc: One who has fallen into depravity: black birds answer instead of white, the magoi is huge and the cost is yours to pay. Cruel, strong and unmistakably dangerous.
dark_rukh_fallen_magi.book_lore: Rough-written, as if by someone who could not stop their hand.

dark_triad_hexer.name: Dark Triad Hexer
dark_triad_hexer.desc: A hex-caster in the old tradition: a touch of rot, a whisper of bad luck and a promise of worse. Nothing you cast is loud, and nothing is forgotten.
dark_triad_hexer.book_lore: Pages of tight handwriting that grow slightly warm when read after dark.

debuff_stack_doctrine.name: Debuff Stack Doctrine
debuff_stack_doctrine.desc: Nothing in the system forbids stacking every penalty on one target. Poison, weaken, slow, mark: by the time he strikes, the foe is already half beaten.
debuff_stack_doctrine.book_lore: One status is nothing. Nine is a sentence.

demon_king_of_salvation.name: Demon King of Salvation
demon_king_of_salvation.desc: A feared mask worn to protect people from worse. The hero's wrath is dark, the savior's hand is gentle, and neither of them backs down.
demon_king_of_salvation.book_lore: Some saviors are loved, and some are only obeyed, and he accepted both.

devil_union_vessel.name: Devil Union Vessel
devil_union_vessel.desc: A body that has taken a devil in: gain terrible claws, hunger and a power that costs you something each time. Hold the thing inside or let it out.
devil_union_vessel.book_lore: A contract in a hand not entirely human, with a very long list of conditions.

diamond_crystal_bulwark.name: Diamond Crystal Bulwark
diamond_crystal_bulwark.desc: A knight of crystal and patience: grow a wall of faceted stone around yourself and your allies, make the enemy come to you, and give back what they hit you with.
diamond_crystal_bulwark.book_lore: Stonemason's drawings of fortifications, with a margin note that reads 'the wall is the weapon'.

dian_cecht_healer.name: Dian Cecht Healer
dian_cecht_healer.desc: The familia of medics: pulses of mending, tonics for the party, antiseptic wards and a shock of smelling salts when someone nods off at the wrong moment.
dian_cecht_healer.book_lore: You bring them back. They owe you nothing but a bad joke.

djinn_mirage.name: Djinn's Mirage
djinn_mirage.desc: A heat-haze magic invented in the spirit of the desert peoples: false images, whispers, and sand that slips away. The foe attacks what is not there.
djinn_mirage.book_lore: What you see is what the desert wants you to see.

dokkaebi_bundle.name: Dokkaebi Bundle
dokkaebi_bundle.desc: A goblin trader's grab-bag of tricks. You never know what comes out of the bundle: smoke, coins, a stumble or a stroke of luck.
dokkaebi_bundle.book_lore: Everything is for sale, including the thing that is not in the bundle.

double_dungeon_survivor.name: Double Dungeon Survivor
double_dungeon_survivor.book_name: Account of the Room That Doesn't Let You Out
double_dungeon_survivor.desc: Live through the room nobody was supposed to walk out of: smoke and rubble, spite-reflecting wards and the strength that only shows up when you are down to your last heart.
double_dungeon_survivor.book_lore: Seven survivors. Four did not need to be told twice.

dragon_king_antares.name: Dragon Monarch's Breath
dragon_king_antares.book_name: Chronicle of the Monarch of Destruction
dragon_king_antares.desc: The power of Antares, Monarch of Destruction and King of Dragons: a roar that breaks the spirit, a breath that erases whatever it touches and a curse that stores every blow for the day the Monarch finally wakes.
dragon_king_antares.book_lore: The oldest of the nine never raised his voice. He did not have to; the sky did it for him.

dragon_nova_milim.name: Dragon Nova of the Destroyer
dragon_nova_milim.desc: The strongest and the most careless: she wins fights with one punch and starts the next before the dust settles. Raw dragon force with no restraint and a childlike grin.
dragon_nova_milim.book_lore: She wanted to play. The mountain was in the way.

dragon_will.name: Indrath's Dragon Will
dragon_will.desc: The will of the great dragon's lineage. A proud style of breath, claws and wings, that stands over the field and judges it.
dragon_will.book_lore: Pride is a dragon's first armor.

dryad_world_tree.name: Treyni's World Tree Blessing
dryad_world_tree.desc: The forest guardian's craft: roots that bind, bark that blocks, and light that mends. Nature as a healer and a jailer.
dryad_world_tree.book_lore: The tree remembers every footstep in the forest.

dungeon_conqueror_captain.name: Dungeon Conqueror Captain
dungeon_conqueror_captain.desc: A merchant-king's bearing: a crew at your back, a chart of the next dungeon in your coat and a surprising amount of luck. You lead from the front and divide the spoils.
dungeon_conqueror_captain.book_lore: Sea charts annotated with dungeon entrances and prices.

dungeon_supporter.name: Supporter's Pack
dungeon_supporter.desc: The porter who makes the dive possible: potion rounds, thrown bombs, escape powder and a pack so well organized that loot never gets left behind.
dungeon_supporter.book_lore: If it's not in the pack, it was never going to save you.

dwarf_guardian.name: Dwarf Guardian
dwarf_guardian.desc: Planted behind a shield and wielding a heavy axe: take the hit, return it, drink to your health and hold the line while the party does what it must.
dwarf_guardian.book_lore: He is not slow. He simply refuses to be elsewhere.

dwarven_forge.name: Dwarven Forge-Art
dwarven_forge.desc: The stonework and steel of the dwarves. Tempering your body, hurling rivets and forging plates in mid-fight: a heavy, grounded line that rewards digging in.
dwarven_forge.book_lore: Tap it twice. If it rings, it holds.

elemental_resist_meta.name: Elemental Resist Meta
elemental_resist_meta.desc: Swap the gear set to the enemy's element. Fire boss: fire ward. Ice dragon: frost ward. The knight who counters the element does not need to win the damage race.
elemental_resist_meta.book_lore: Know the element, wear the opposite, and the fight is a formality.

elenoir_wind_weaver.name: Elenoir Wind-Weaver
elenoir_wind_weaver.desc: Elf wind magic: blades of air, a gale to lift friends, a step that skips the ground. A fast, elegant caster who never quite stays where the foe thinks she is.
elenoir_wind_weaver.book_lore: The forest hums. Learn the tune.

elven_rite_bearer.name: Elven Rite Bearer
elven_rite_bearer.desc: A soul that remembers an elf's life: green-and-white mana, a deep trust in the forest and a power that rises when the people you love are in danger.
elven_rite_bearer.book_lore: The elves' funeral songs, written down for the first time by someone who survived them.

ember_flame_art.name: Elemental Art: Ember Flame
ember_flame_art.book_name: Ember Primer of the Fire Mage
ember_flame_art.desc: Plain, honest fire magic from Dicathen's casters. Sparks, spears and wheels of flame, and a finisher that sets a whole lane of the field alight.
ember_flame_art.book_lore: Fire asks only to be fed.

endure_ability.name: Developmental Ability: Endure
endure_ability.desc: Outlast everything: a body that shrugs off blows, regenerates in a pinch and hands back some of the pain. The patient face of Level-up growth.
endure_ability.book_lore: Winning is optional. Being there at the end is not.

erza_requip_knight.name: Requip: The Knight
erza_requip_knight.desc: Erza Scarlet's Requip: swap armor and weapon in the middle of a fight, one pocket dimension of gear at a time. Each swap leaves a blow waiting on the foe, and a long road of kills ends in the Armadura Fairy and its rain of swords.
erza_requip_knight.book_lore: Every blade she needs is already waiting in the pocket dimension: she only has to call it.

extreme_magic_adept.name: Extreme Magic Adept
extreme_magic_adept.desc: You have learned to pour the whole wellspring into a single spell. Between the great ones you rest, guard and charge: every cast is an event.
extreme_magic_adept.book_lore: A lecture in print: three pages of theory, two of warnings and one blank page for 'regrets'.

fanalis_brawler.name: Fanalis Brawler
fanalis_brawler.desc: A body built to leap higher, strike harder and outrun the magic aimed at it: no wand, no Djinn, just a ferocious physique. Kicks that crack stone and a grin while you do it.
fanalis_brawler.book_lore: Scribbled by a trainer who clearly could not keep up with the subject.

flame_djinn_swordsman.name: Flame Djinn Swordsman
flame_djinn_swordsman.desc: Equip the spirit of a fire Djinn into your blade: the sword burns, the cloak burns, and the heat answers your every swing. Sheer, honest fire-melee.
flame_djinn_swordsman.book_lore: A scorched manual from a dungeon capturer who forgot to put the sword down before sleeping.

flame_spirit_ifrit.name: Ifrit's Flame Mantle
flame_spirit_ifrit.desc: A flame spirit bound to a fighter: a cloak of fire that hurts what touches it and a body that does not mind burning. More shield than sword, but the shield burns.
flame_spirit_ifrit.book_lore: The fire is not his enemy. It is his coat.

flute_magi_prodigy.name: Flute Magi Prodigy
flute_magi_prodigy.desc: A child of cheerful, boundless magoi with a flute and a patient guardian in the wings. Playful, strangely powerful and given to sudden, enormous spells.
flute_magi_prodigy.book_lore: A fluting guide with a bookmark in a chapter about 'not showing off'.

fog_troupe_bandit.name: Fog Troupe Bandit
fog_troupe_bandit.desc: A thief with a cause: smoke bombs, rooftops and an eye for the one purse that matters. Strike fast, vanish faster and never keep what you steal for yourself.
fog_troupe_bandit.book_lore: A list of rooftops, guard rotations and who owes whom a favor.

fourth_wall.name: Fourth Wall
fourth_wall.desc: The invisible barrier between the reader and the story. Hold it up and nothing of the scenario can touch you; drop it and everything touches back.
fourth_wall.book_lore: Between the reader and the page there is a wall that no scenario was written to cross.

freya_charm.name: Charm of the Goddess
freya_charm.desc: Beauty as a weapon: monsters drawn in, entranced, weakened and softened by a goddess's favour that spares the allies. Inspired by the Goddess of Beauty's familia.
freya_charm.book_lore: To be looked at is to be spoken for.

frost_djinn_blade.name: Frost Djinn Blade
frost_djinn_blade.desc: An ice Djinn's armor and sword: slow the field to a crawl, lock the enemies in frost and win the long fights. Cold, deliberate and entirely unhurried.
frost_djinn_blade.book_lore: A frost-rimed treatise on fighting at your enemy's pace, which is to say, a slower one than you.

frost_monarch.name: Monarch of Frost
frost_monarch.desc: Command a blizzard that never melts: glacial roads, flash freezes and a mantle of snow that keeps the cold in your favour.
frost_monarch.book_lore: Cold is not the absence of heat. It is a decision.

goh_apollo_charyeok.name: Apollo's Charyeok
goh_apollo_charyeok.desc: Borrow the sun god's gifts: healing light, a golden beam and a glare that blinds. Gentle with friends, a solar flare to foes.
goh_apollo_charyeok.book_lore: Best read at noon. At night it quietly glows.

goh_ares_charyeok.name: Ares's Charyeok
goh_ares_charyeok.book_name: Field Manual of the Red Banner
goh_ares_charyeok.desc: Borrow the war god's rage: a roar that rallies the front line, charges that crack shields and a fury that grows with every fallen enemy.
goh_ares_charyeok.book_lore: Page eleven is stained. Page twelve is missing.

goh_artemis_charyeok.name: Artemis's Charyeok
goh_artemis_charyeok.desc: Borrow the huntress's moon-bright bow: silver arrows, rain of arrows, a mark on the quarry and a silent step through the trees. A sniper whose prey never sees the shot.
goh_artemis_charyeok.book_lore: Every page has a single name and a single arrow.

goh_athena_charyeok.name: Athena's Charyeok
goh_athena_charyeok.desc: Borrow the goddess of wisdom's aegis: a shield for yourself and your allies, a mark on the weak point and a spear thrown with perfect aim. A fighter who plans two moves ahead.
goh_athena_charyeok.book_lore: Every plan has a second plan underlined twice.

goh_capoeira.name: Capoeira Ginga
goh_capoeira.desc: Dance and fight of the roda: constant swaying, hand-stands, sweeping low kicks and moves from upside-down. Hard to hit, harder to read.
goh_capoeira.book_lore: The lyrics tell you how to move; the footnotes tell you what to do about the knife.

goh_charyeok_vessel.name: Charyeok Vessel
goh_charyeok_vessel.desc: A body that can hold a borrowed power. You draw a spirit's strength into yourself and spend it as bursts, beams, blinks and borrowed armor. Flexible, raw and unfinished.
goh_charyeok_vessel.book_lore: Terms: you may keep it until it wants to leave.

goh_hades_charyeok.name: Hades's Charyeok
goh_hades_charyeok.desc: Borrow the lord of the dead's grasp: shadow that pulls, drains and withers. The weaker the foe, the quicker it falls to your hand.
goh_hades_charyeok.book_lore: Every name in it is crossed off, eventually.

goh_haetae_jade.name: Haetae to Jade Emperor
goh_haetae_jade.desc: Han Daewi's water Charyeok: the young Haetae's bubbles, waves and hard water grow, through a direct contract, into the Jade Emperor's Wisdom of the Sage. Endure enough punishment and the water becomes gravity itself.
goh_haetae_jade.book_lore: The first pages are damp and written in a child's hand; the last ones are dry, heavy, and press down on the desk.

goh_hapkido.name: Hapkido Redirect
goh_hapkido.desc: Joint locks, wrist turns and soft redirection that make the attacker break their own balance. A calm, close and tricky style.
goh_hapkido.book_lore: A manual of eleven wrist turns and one very long warning.

goh_hephaestus_charyeok.name: Hephaestus's Charyeok
goh_hephaestus_charyeok.desc: Borrow the smith god's forge: weapons hammered out of nothing, an anvil dropped from above and hot metal chains. You fight from a burning workshop.
goh_hephaestus_charyeok.book_lore: Burned at the edges, nine times corrected in the margins.

goh_heracles_labors.name: Heracles's Labors
goh_heracles_labors.desc: Borrow the hero of the twelve labors: a lion-skin hide, a hydra's regrowth, a stag's speed and a strength that has beaten monsters. You are built to fight things bigger than you.
goh_heracles_labors.book_lore: Eleven are done. The twelfth is sitting in front of you.

goh_hermes_charyeok.name: Hermes's Charyeok
goh_hermes_charyeok.desc: Borrow the messenger god's winged sandals: bursts of impossible speed, darts in a flurry and a blur of afterimages. You win by never being where the blow lands.

goh_ilpyo_sword.name: Ilpyo's Family Blade
goh_ilpyo_sword.desc: Park Ilpyo's sword of the Park family, drawn on Ssam-su Taekkyeon footwork and lit by the fox flame of the Nine-Tails Guardian. Cut down enough foes and the ninth tail is let loose.
goh_ilpyo_sword.book_lore: Every page is a name struck through in silver ink; the last one is singed at the edge, and nine thin fox hairs are pressed into the spine.

goh_judo.name: Judo Throw
goh_judo.desc: The gentle way, turned into a weapon: grab, unbalance and throw. You use the foe's own weight, and the mat is always near.
goh_judo.book_lore: A folded belt is tucked between the pages.

goh_jumeok_fist.name: Jumeok Fist
goh_jumeok_fist.desc: Pure fist-fighting: jabs, hooks, hammer fists and a punch heavy enough to send a shock along the floor. A brawler who ends fights in a few blows.
goh_jumeok_fist.book_lore: No pictures, just bruises in the margins.

goh_kendo.name: Kendo Way of the Sword
goh_kendo.desc: Discipline with a bamboo or steel sword: a straight cut, a loud kiai and a calm after-strike. Few moves, flawlessly timed.
goh_kendo.book_lore: Strike where you look, look where you strike, and never look away.

goh_ki_cultivation.name: Ki Cultivation
goh_ki_cultivation.desc: Breath, focus and the flow of Ki through the body. Close your eyes, gather the glow and let it out as a beam, a ring or a healing breath.
goh_ki_cultivation.book_lore: Eleven pages of breathing exercises and one of regret.

goh_lu_bu_moonlight.name: Yeo-Po Bong-Seon
goh_lu_bu_moonlight.desc: Yoo Mira's Moonlight Sword Style, a wooden blade that cuts steel, joined to the Charyeok of Lu Bu and his flying horse Red Hare. Cut down enough foes and the hero of legend rides with you.
goh_lu_bu_moonlight.book_lore: The twenty-fifth name on the scroll is still wet; a horse's hoofprint is pressed into the last page.

goh_mighty_style.name: Mighty Style
goh_mighty_style.desc: Fight with sheer, unbelievable strength: boulders for fists, a shout that rattles the arena and a stomp that opens the floor. No tricks; just a bigger hammer.
goh_mighty_style.book_lore: Everything in it is measured in how far it flew.

goh_monkey_king.name: Monkey King's Charyeok
goh_monkey_king.desc: Borrow the Great Sage's trickery: an extending staff, cloud somersaults, hair that turns into clones and an unbeatable grin. Fast, playful and very hard to pin down.
goh_monkey_king.book_lore: Nobody has ever actually read this one: it keeps changing its own title.

goh_muay_thai.name: Muay Thai Clinch
goh_muay_thai.desc: The art of eight limbs: elbows, knees, shins and a clinch that drags the foe in close. Slow to start, brutal at close range.
goh_muay_thai.book_lore: Every entry is a shin bruise with a date next to it.

goh_nyuh_weapon_forms.name: Nyuh Weapon Forms
goh_nyuh_weapon_forms.desc: Shape your Ki into a weapon and fight with it: spear, blade, bow, chain and shield, each its own form that you switch between in the middle of a fight.
goh_nyuh_weapon_forms.book_lore: A fold-out chart of eleven weapons, none of which you can actually hold.

goh_pankration_grappler.name: Pankration Grappler
goh_pankration_grappler.desc: Wrestling and all-in grappling: tackles, suplexes, pins and a taunt that makes the other side lose their heads. Dirty and fair at once.
goh_pankration_grappler.book_lore: The scorecard is covered in dirt and several footprints.

goh_poseidon.name: Poseidon's Charyeok
goh_poseidon.desc: Borrow the sea god's command of water: tidal waves, whirlpools that drag foes in and a trident of surging blue light. Tough and forceful.
goh_poseidon.book_lore: The pages are always damp, whatever you do.

goh_taejin_charyeok.name: Taejin's Renewal Charyeok
goh_taejin_charyeok.desc: Jin Taejin, the old master of Renewal Taekwondo, a style made to kill gods, and a man who bears borrowed power's price. Survive enough blows that should have killed you and the old master's miracle answers.
goh_taejin_charyeok.book_lore: The handwriting is shaky and the margins are full of kick diagrams; one line, underlined twice, says that a god can bleed like anyone.

goh_taekwondo.name: Taekwondo Kicker
goh_taekwondo.desc: Korean kicking art built on speed, height and hip power. Flying side kicks, axe kicks from above and a tornado kick that clears the ring.
goh_taekwondo.book_lore: The first rule in the margin: if your foot is not higher than their head, you are late.

goh_tiger_crane_kungfu.name: Tiger and Crane Kung Fu
goh_tiger_crane_kungfu.desc: Two classic animal styles in one body: the tiger's claw for power, the crane's wing for balance and evasion. Hard strikes, then a hop away.
goh_tiger_crane_kungfu.book_lore: The tiger paragraphs are underlined in red; the crane paragraphs in white.

goh_tournament_contender.name: Tournament Contender
goh_tournament_contender.desc: You fight in the bracket: warm-up, read your opponent, counter the opening and finish in front of the crowd. Every round teaches you more.
goh_tournament_contender.book_lore: Each page is a round. The last page is blank: that is the final.

goh_zeus_charyeok.name: Zeus's Charyeok
goh_zeus_charyeok.book_name: Thunder Ledger of the Sky King
goh_zeus_charyeok.desc: Borrow the king of the gods' thunder: lightning steps, forks of lightning and a clap that stuns a hall. Fast, loud and bright.
goh_zeus_charyeok.book_lore: It sparks if you touch the cover with wet hands.

golden_dawn_prodigy.name: Golden Dawn Prodigy
golden_dawn_prodigy.desc: The elite of the elite: refined technique, effortless composure and a reservoir of mana that mocks everyone else. Every spell lands clean and on time.
golden_dawn_prodigy.book_lore: Gilded-edge lessons from an academy that only accepts the gifted.

goldsmith_radiance.name: Goldsmith Radiance
goldsmith_radiance.desc: A noble sword-line of sunlit steel, invented in the story's spirit: bright strikes, dazzling flashes and a charge that lights up the field. Strongest in daylight.
goldsmith_radiance.book_lore: Polish the steel until it holds the sun.

goliath_colossal_fist.name: Goliath, the Colossal Fist
goliath_colossal_fist.desc: The strongest Fighter on the continent: wading in, throwing boulders, stamping the ground flat and hitting like a falling building. Inspired by the nation-level Fighter class of the story.
goliath_colossal_fist.book_lore: Subtlety is for people who cannot lift the building.

gray_ice_make.name: Ice-Make
gray_ice_make.desc: Gray Fullbuster's two-handed ice sorcery: shape lances, floors, hammers and saucers out of cold, then grow into the Ice Devil Slayer's blizzard. Frostbite stores the cold on your foes and lets it bite later, until the Iced Shell seals everything in absolute zero.
gray_ice_make.book_lore: Cast with both hands, the way Ur taught: whatever you can picture, you can freeze into shape.

great_sage_analysis.name: Great Sage of Thought Acceleration
great_sage_analysis.book_name: Records of the Voice in the Mind
great_sage_analysis.desc: A calm voice in the mind that analyzes, predicts and runs a thousand thoughts at once. It sees the weakness before you swing and the counter before they strike.
great_sage_analysis.book_lore: Answer: the enemy will strike left. Recommend: step right.

greatsword_doctrine.name: Greatsword Doctrine
greatsword_doctrine.desc: Slow swings that end whole skirmishes. Every strike is committed and wide, with knockback to match; the stance changes how a greatsword reads the room.
greatsword_doctrine.book_lore: The sword is too heavy to swing twice. He only needs once.

green_mantis_ambusher.name: Green Mantis Ambusher
green_mantis_ambusher.desc: A forest hunter who strikes from the leaves: still as a branch, then gone. Kills are quick, quiet, and nobody saw you at all.
green_mantis_ambusher.book_lore: Pressed leaves, whittled tips and a very short chapter on being seen.

grimoire_page_scholar.name: Grimoire Page Scholar
grimoire_page_scholar.desc: A mage who treats the grimoire as a library: tear out a page, cast it, turn to the next. Quick-fire spells, cross-referenced foes and a talent for finding what others missed.
grimoire_page_scholar.book_lore: A grimoire's margin notes, collected into a book of their own.

grinding_protocol.name: Grinding Protocol
grinding_protocol.book_name: Route Notes of the Endless Clearing
grinding_protocol.desc: Patience turned into power: pull a whole spawn into a clearing, clear it with efficient sweeps, and let experience and loot pile up. Slow to start, ruinous to everyone else's loot tables.
grinding_protocol.book_lore: The same room, a thousand times, and the thousand-and-first gives a drop.

guardian_absolute_defense.name: Uriel's Absolute Defense
guardian_absolute_defense.book_name: Oath of the Lord of Guardian
guardian_absolute_defense.desc: The guardian's power: an impenetrable barrier that shields allies, absorbs what comes, and lets the attacker taste a measure of what he sent.
guardian_absolute_defense.book_lore: Nothing was ever behind him that was hurt.

hakurou_blade_way.name: Hakurou's Way of the Blade
hakurou_blade_way.desc: A swordsman who taught a whole army to draw: mirror-still iaijutsu, quick echoes and clean parries. Every blow is one stroke, and one stroke is enough.
hakurou_blade_way.book_lore: He sheathed it before they noticed he had drawn.

haruhime_uchide.name: Uchide no Kozuchi
haruhime_uchide.desc: The Renard priestess's Level Boost: a chanted prayer that lifts every ally near you one step beyond their limit, fox-tails that carry the blessing to many at once, and a quiet debt that the borrowed strength always asks back. Evolves once you have reached three hundred allies with your blessings.
haruhime_uchide.book_lore: She cannot lift herself. She has never needed to; she lifts everyone else, and then asks them kindly to come home.

heart_kingdom_lifebinder.name: Heart Kingdom Lifebinder
heart_kingdom_lifebinder.desc: A gentle gardener-healer of the heart-shaped kingdom: wounds close under your hands, vines hold the enemy, and the people you stand beside simply refuse to fall.
heart_kingdom_lifebinder.book_lore: Pressed petals with healing notes in a looping hand and a recipe for tea.

heewon_righteous_knight.name: Heewon's Righteous Blade
heewon_righteous_knight.desc: A knight's sword sworn to protect. Shield the weak, heal the party and bring down the wicked with a beam of light.
heewon_righteous_knight.book_lore: A promise to be kind is the hardest one to keep in a world like this.

hellflare_flame_lord.name: Hellflare Flame Lord
hellflare_flame_lord.desc: The black flame of an ogre noble turned commander: a disciplined fire that burns what it is told to burn. Flame as an army's front line, with swords and arrows made of fire.
hellflare_flame_lord.book_lore: Flame is not rage. It is obedience, and it obeys him.

hephaistos_forge.name: Hephaistos Forge-Master
hephaistos_forge.desc: Wear your workshop on the battlefield: tempered plates, hammer arcs, whetstone focus and a party that comes out better equipped than it went in.
hephaistos_forge.book_lore: Everything breaks. A smith is the one who brings the next one.

hestia_falna.name: Falna: Hestia's Blessing
hestia_falna.desc: The goddess's mark on your back: Status that climbs with every dungeon floor, experience that never wastes and a hearth to come home to.
hestia_falna.book_lore: A small goddess, a smaller church, and a back that keeps getting stronger.

hestia_knife.name: Hestia Knife
hestia_knife.desc: A divine dagger that shines with its owner's Blessing: quick cuts, thrown blades and a thrust through the one chink in the armor.
hestia_knife.book_lore: The blade is the one thing in the room that never stops getting stronger.

hidden_class_berserker.name: Hidden Class: Berserker Knight
hidden_class_berserker.desc: A class no menu lists: unlocked by being near death at the right level with the right weapon. Hits harder the more it bleeds, and heals itself by hitting.
hidden_class_berserker.book_lore: It only appears for those who ignore the warnings.

hinata_moonlit_blade.name: Hinata's Moonlit Blade
hinata_moonlit_blade.desc: A holy knight's discipline: a mirrored sword style that reads the opponent, punishes the unholy and holds the line. Cool, clean and exact.
hinata_moonlit_blade.book_lore: She saw the strike before he thought of it.

hoarfrost_art.name: Elemental Art: Hoarfrost
hoarfrost_art.desc: Water gone cold: a mage who holds the field still. Freezing breaths, a glacier shell and a road of ice for the fastest slide in the north.
hoarfrost_art.book_lore: Cold is only patience made visible.

household_vessel_wielder.name: Household Vessel Wielder
household_vessel_wielder.desc: A lamp, a kettle, a rolling pin: ordinary things a Djinn once whispered into. Not a true equip, but handy, strange and always within reach.
household_vessel_wielder.book_lore: A pamphlet filed between cookbooks, which is the only reason it survived the purge.

hunter_ability.name: Developmental Ability: Hunter
hunter_ability.desc: The Level-up ability of a monster-slayer: spotting weak points, harvesting more from each kill and cleaving through whatever the dungeon spawns.
hunter_ability.book_lore: Every monster is just a lesson with a long tail.

hunter_healer.name: Hunter-Class Healer
hunter_healer.desc: The raid's lifeline: light that mends the whole party, barriers that hold the line and a dazzling flash that buys everyone a moment to breathe.
hunter_healer.book_lore: You are not here to fight. You are here so they can.

hunter_mage.name: Hunter-Class Mage
hunter_mage.desc: A glass cannon with a library in her head: arcane lances, chain lightning, short-range blinks and a meteor on a long cooldown.
hunter_mage.book_lore: Three words, four seconds, and the room changes.

hunter_ranger.name: Hunter-Class Ranger
hunter_ranger.desc: Death at a distance: pinning shots, rolling backsteps and a rain of arrows for the hunter who never lets the boss close the gap.
hunter_ranger.book_lore: The best place to stand is wherever it is not.

hunter_sword_dance.name: Hunter Sword Dance
hunter_sword_dance.desc: A swordswoman's flowing style: crescents of steel, water-soft steps and a still-water cut that arrives before the foe knows. Inspired by the S-rank sword hunters of the story.
hunter_sword_dance.book_lore: The blade is just the last inch of the dance.

igris_blood_red.name: Igris, the Blood-Red Knight
igris_blood_red.desc: Fight beside the crimson knight whose swordsmanship you inherited: clean arcs, brutal executions and a never-yielding oath.
igris_blood_red.book_lore: Kneel only to your Monarch; everything else gets the blade.

imperial_fan_dancer.name: Imperial Fan Dancer
imperial_fan_dancer.desc: Court grace with an edge: war fans that cut like blades, a perfume that dulls the senses and a dance that soothes your friends. Every step is a flourish.
imperial_fan_dancer.book_lore: Illustrated steps for a dance that starts at a banquet and ends in a duel.

invincibility_frames.name: I-Frame Dodge Mastery
invincibility_frames.desc: A dodge is not a movement, it is a window in which nothing can hurt you. Time it, and the strongest attack in the room passes through. Miss it, and you are plainly mortal.
invincibility_frames.book_lore: For one beat the sword went through him. He only blinked.

iron_body_monarch.name: Monarch of the Iron Body
iron_body_monarch.desc: Fight bare-skinned and unafraid: a body hardened into living steel that needs no armor, shrugs off falling anvils and answers with open-handed hammer blows.
iron_body_monarch.book_lore: Armor is for people who plan to be hit. He plans to be hit and not care.

iron_shadow_guard.name: Iron, the Shadow Vanguard
iron_shadow_guard.desc: A towering tank-soldier of the shadow army: planted feet, a wall of dark steel and a roar that makes every enemy look at him.
iron_shadow_guard.book_lore: They said nothing passes. Nothing has.

jihye_twin_blades.name: Twin Blades of Lee Jihye
jihye_twin_blades.book_name: Pocket Diary of a Dual Swordswoman
jihye_twin_blades.desc: A young swordswoman who fights with two blades and no fear. Fast chains, quick bursts and a rhythm that keeps getting faster.
jihye_twin_blades.book_lore: She says she is not brave; she just hates losing more than she fears the dark.

kamish_wrath.name: Kamish's Wrath
kamish_wrath.desc: The fury of a slain dragon bound in a dagger: diving fire, black flame beams and scales that laugh at heat and lightning.
kamish_wrath.book_lore: It died once. Its anger did not get the memo.

kasaka_venom_fang.name: Kasaka's Venom Fang
kasaka_venom_fang.desc: A poison-dripping dagger and the serpent's patience: lunge, poison and wait for the venom to finish the job.
kasaka_venom_fang.book_lore: Cut once. The rest is arithmetic.

labyrinth_maker_ramiris.name: Ramiris's Labyrinth Maker
labyrinth_maker_ramiris.book_name: Floor Plan of the Fairy Queen
labyrinth_maker_ramiris.desc: The fairy queen's craft: a dungeon is just a very polite spell. Warp between rooms, lock a pack in a corridor and let the walls do the arguing.
labyrinth_maker_ramiris.book_lore: She made the maze for fun. It did not stay fun for visitors.

lady_luck.name: Lady Luck
lady_luck.desc: The gambler's skill of The Exiled Heavy Knight: a passive Luck stat, a cat that bats a killing blow aside, strikes that crit when they should not, and a coin that is not always fair.
lady_luck.book_lore: The pages are a deck of worn cards. Anyone who reads it feels they are being watched, kindly, by a cat.

lance_bulwark.name: Lance Bulwark
lance_bulwark.desc: The Lance who is the wall: terrain, shields and patience. This line absorbs, locks the field in place and turns the foes' own force against them.
lance_bulwark.book_lore: You cannot break what has not moved in a hundred years.

lance_shadowblade.name: Lance Shadowblade
lance_shadowblade.desc: The quiet Lance: smoke, knives and a clean finish. A stealth-assassin line of fast exits, marked targets and decisive single cuts.
lance_shadowblade.book_lore: You never meet the Lance who killed you.

lance_vanguard.name: Lance Vanguard
lance_vanguard.desc: The Lance who leads the charge: a commander's kit of taunts, rallies and heavy lines of steel. Strongest at the head of a group.
lance_vanguard.book_lore: Where the Lance stands, the line holds.

laxus_lightning_dragon.name: Lightning Dragon Slayer
laxus_lightning_dragon.desc: Laxus Dreyar's Lightning Dragon Slayer magic: fast, heavy and loud, with a body that eats lightning and a storm that answers every blow. Each hit leaves a static charge on the foe, until the Red Lightning Dragon Mode discharges every one of them.
laxus_lightning_dragon.book_lore: A grandson's grudge, a dragon's heart and a storm that never ran dry: thunder has to be earned.

legionary_phalanx_shield.name: Legionary Phalanx Shield
legionary_phalanx_shield.desc: A drilled soldier of a shield-and-spear army: fight shoulder to shoulder, advance in step and be the reason the line holds. Discipline as a weapon.
legionary_phalanx_shield.book_lore: A manual of the formations in a clear, square hand; no flourishes.

liaris_freese.name: Liaris Freese
liaris_freese.book_name: Notes on a Rapidly Growing Wish
liaris_freese.desc: Power that grows from longing: the harder you chase the person ahead, the faster you rise. Rapid boosts, steady recovery and an unreasonable amount of experience.
liaris_freese.book_lore: Admiration, it turns out, is a kind of fuel.

little_rookie.name: Little Rookie's Courage
little_rookie.desc: A small adventurer facing something far too big: gather your nerve, hit it from below, throw everything you have and refuse to look away.
little_rookie.book_lore: The trick, apparently, is to keep going after it is no longer a good idea.

loot_duplication_glitch.name: Loot Duplication Glitch
loot_duplication_glitch.desc: A loophole in the loot table: every kill pays twice if you know when to look away. He turns a drop table into an income.
loot_duplication_glitch.book_lore: Do not look at the chest while the monster dies. It pays out twice.

luminous_wind.name: Luminous Wind
luminous_wind.book_name: Hooded Notes of the Quiet Elf
luminous_wind.desc: The quiet elf's wind: a hooded silence, a breeze that helps friends and cuts foes, and a precise blow when the moment is right. Part assassin, part healer.
luminous_wind.book_lore: Revenge keeps well. Kindness keeps better.

magic_broom_aerialist.name: Magic Broom Aerialist
magic_broom_aerialist.desc: The sky is your battlefield: ride a broom, dive from above and never let your feet settle. Fast, hard to catch and best at the moment of landing.
magic_broom_aerialist.book_lore: A log of hard landings and one very good tip for leaning into a turn.

magic_carpet_rider.name: Magic Carpet Rider
magic_carpet_rider.desc: A woven carpet that carries a friend, a cushion for a wound and a trick or two up its fringe. You support, swoop and sit down only when it is safe.
magic_carpet_rider.book_lore: A manual with a pattern of folding and a warning about what happens when you let go.

magic_knight_duelist.name: Magic Knight Duelist
magic_knight_duelist.desc: A sword-and-spell fencer of the magic knight exams: clean parries, cleaner ripostes and a fixed idea that any fight can be won in three moves. Precise, proud and never in a hurry.
magic_knight_duelist.book_lore: Marked up with the diagrams of three hundred prior exam bouts, most of them won.

magic_tool_artificer.name: Magic Tool Artificer
magic_tool_artificer.desc: Why cast when you can build? Carry a satchel of spring-loaded gadgets, rune-etched plates and a deployable decoy, and win by preparation instead of power.
magic_tool_artificer.book_lore: A greasy workbook of blueprints, with a corner burned off where the experiment went wrong.

magnostadt_staff_wizard.name: Magnostadt Staff Wizard
magnostadt_staff_wizard.desc: A wizard of the great academy: you carry a staff, cast from a book of formulas and rely on training instead of talent. Fast casting, broad spellbook, steady hands.
magnostadt_staff_wizard.book_lore: Neat columns of spell formulas, graded in red ink by a stern examiner.
arts: Great Formula: Fall of the Stars

magoi_siphoner.name: Magoi Siphoner
magoi_siphoner.desc: You do not make power; you take it. Every blow draws a thread of the foe's magoi into you, and the longer a fight goes on, the more you have to spend.
magoi_siphoner.book_lore: A thin treatise that disapproves of its own subject and then explains it in detail.

mana_beast_hunter.name: Mana Beast Hunter
mana_beast_hunter.desc: An adventurer's kit for the Beast Glades: trap, bait, patch up and finish. A practical, unglamorous line that gets the loot home.
mana_beast_hunter.book_lore: Read the tracks, respect the teeth, count the loot.

mana_rotation.name: Mana Rotation
mana_rotation.desc: Keep the core turning and the body never tires. A tempo line: ramp up through the fight, recover while moving, and burst when the rotation is at its fastest.

mana_skin_brawler.name: Mana Skin Brawler
mana_skin_brawler.desc: Wrap your body in raw mana like a second hide and fight with fists alone. No grimoire spell, only muscle, mana flow and stubbornness.
mana_skin_brawler.book_lore: A beaten-up manual on pushing mana out through the skin instead of through a spell.

mana_zone_sentinel.name: Mana Zone Sentinel
mana_zone_sentinel.desc: Spread your mana into the air around you and feel every living thing that moves inside it. You never fight blind: you read the strike before it comes.
mana_zone_sentinel.book_lore: Written by a scout who swore she could hear a bowstring drawn three hills away.

metal_vessel_conqueror.name: Metal Vessel Conqueror
metal_vessel_conqueror.desc: A hero who has beaten a dungeon and wears the Djinn's armor: full equip, a golden aura and a presence that makes lesser fighters stop and stare.
metal_vessel_conqueror.book_lore: A conqueror's logbook: the dungeon, the Djinn, and a cheerful, stark 'worth it'.

min_max_build.name: Min-Max Build Theory
min_max_build.desc: Every stat point goes exactly where it pays off most. Switch allocations on the fly between a cannon and a wall, then spend your cleverness on beams and burst.
min_max_build.book_lore: Nothing is wasted: every point has a job.

monarchs_domain.name: Monarch's Domain
monarchs_domain.desc: Claim the ground around you as your own territory: pressure that pins, crushes and drags foes while you stand untouched at its centre.
monarchs_domain.book_lore: Within the Domain, even gravity asks permission.

monster_tamer.name: Tamer's Bond
monster_tamer.desc: Befriend what the dungeon throws at you: calling beasts, calming the wild, sharing health with creatures and fighting with their instincts.
monster_tamer.book_lore: Teeth mean something different when they like you.

multi_vessel_warlord.name: Multi-Vessel Warlord
multi_vessel_warlord.desc: A conqueror who wears several Djinn at once: flame, earth and thunder in one body. You fight like an army, and every war has a plan.
multi_vessel_warlord.book_lore: Marching orders for a war of three fronts, written with a flourish.

natsu_fire_dragon.name: Fire Dragon Slayer
natsu_fire_dragon.book_name: Scale of the Fire Dragon Slayer
natsu_fire_dragon.desc: Natsu Dragneel's Fire Dragon Slayer magic: breathe, punch and ram your way through a fight with flame, eat fire to keep going, and never stay down. Every blow leaves embers smouldering on the foe, until the Lightning Fire Dragon Mode sets them all off at once.
natsu_fire_dragon.book_lore: Igneel's lesson was short: eat the flame, and the flame will do what you tell it.

new_game_plus_memory.name: New Game Plus Memory
new_game_plus_memory.book_name: Save File of the Second Playthrough
new_game_plus_memory.desc: Every restart keeps the knowledge. He fights each opponent as if on his second playthrough: he knows what it does, he is already moving, and he is a step ahead of every attack.
new_game_plus_memory.book_lore: Every fight is a replay of one he already won.

oath_of_the_heavy_armor.name: Oath of the Heavy Armor
oath_of_the_heavy_armor.desc: The tank's skill of The Exiled Heavy Knight: stand in front, draw every blade onto yourself and outlast it. Taunts, a wall of resistance, a shield that bites back, and plate that turns the hits aside.
oath_of_the_heavy_armor.book_lore: A dented, iron-bound codex. Its first page reads: 'Whoever is struck first, strikes last.'

ogre_lord_might.name: Ogre Lord's Might
ogre_lord_might.desc: The bodily strength of an ogre lord: enormous blows, a body that closes its own wounds, and a roar that settles every fight. The raw end of the Tempest army's front rank.
ogre_lord_might.book_lore: A little hot-headed. Every wall has noticed.

omniscient_viewpoint.name: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
omniscient_viewpoint.desc: The skill of the one reader who knows how the story ends. Read a foe's weak point, mark it, and finish the scene exactly as the last page says.
omniscient_viewpoint.book_lore: Three thousand and some chapters, and only one person ever finished them.

orc_lord_famine.name: Orc Lord's Famine
orc_lord_famine.book_name: Hunger Songs of the Orc Disaster
orc_lord_famine.desc: A hunger that never stops: it grows on what it eats and leaves its victims starved and weak. The Orc Disaster's hunger turned into a power, brutal and unhurried.
orc_lord_famine.book_lore: He was never full. That was the whole problem.

overweight_build.name: Overweight Build
overweight_build.desc: Wear more armor than the game was ever meant to let you carry. You are slow, you cannot be moved, and what hits you pays for it.
overweight_build.book_lore: The encumbrance bar was red. He kept buying plate.

party_support_rotation.name: Party Support Rotation
party_support_rotation.book_name: Rotation Sheet of the Support Role
party_support_rotation.desc: Not the attacker, not the healer: the knight who keeps the party's buffs up and the heals on time, and whose taunt is a bell. Win a fight by cutting nobody down.
party_support_rotation.book_lore: The kills went to somebody else. The party lived.

perfect_parry_timing.name: Perfect Parry Timing
perfect_parry_timing.desc: Win by being at the right frame: a parry that lands in the narrowest window turns the enemy's own strike into the opening. High risk, huge payoff.
perfect_parry_timing.book_lore: A tenth of a second is wide enough for a whole duel.

plague_monarch.name: Monarch of Plagues
plague_monarch.desc: Command swarms, rot and contagion: a creeping line of poison that spreads from foe to foe and feeds on the dying.
plague_monarch.book_lore: The first cough is the cheapest. The rest are compounding interest.

predator_gluttony.name: Predator of the Hungering Slime
predator_gluttony.desc: Swallow what you fight, learn from what you swallow. A slime's first and hungriest unique skill: it devours, analyzes and feeds the body on everything it takes in.
predator_gluttony.book_lore: It eats the spell, then the spellcaster, then asks for more.

primordial_black_diablo.name: Primordial Black Court
primordial_black_diablo.desc: A demon of darkness who serves with a smile and kills with one: a courtier's elegance over assassin's patience. The darkness itself obeys him.
primordial_black_diablo.book_lore: He bows first. That is the polite part.

primordial_red_destruction.name: Primordial Red's Destruction
primordial_red_destruction.book_name: Ruin Ledger of the Primordial Red
primordial_red_destruction.desc: A demon of ruin: every blow is an unmaking. Chains of disintegration jump from foe to foe, a gaze withers the strongest and the sky itself falls on whoever is marked.
primordial_red_destruction.book_lore: She does not break things. She finishes them.

prisoner_golden_headband.name: Prisoner of the Golden Headband
prisoner_golden_headband.desc: The monkey who once stormed heaven fights with a staff and a grin. Somersault across the sky, bring the pillar down, and split into clones when it gets crowded.
prisoner_golden_headband.book_lore: The headband never came off, but it never stopped him from laughing at heaven.

probability_stories.name: Probability Stories
probability_stories.desc: A story's odds can be bent when the narrator holds enough belief. Tilt chance in your favour: lucky crits, lucky dodges and a lucky escape from death.
probability_stories.book_lore: The impossible is only a story nobody has believed hard enough yet.

puppet_master_clayman.name: Clayman's Puppet Strings
puppet_master_clayman.desc: The puppeteer's art: invisible strings that bind, yank and dance a foe where he is wanted. The wielder never raises his own hand, only a finger.
puppet_master_clayman.book_lore: He pulled the string. Everyone else took the stage.

purple_orca_tidecaller.name: Purple Orca Tidecaller
purple_orca_tidecaller.desc: A seafarer who sings the tide into shape: heal the crew, ward them with brine and drag the foe under with the current. Calm in a storm, fiercer when the water rises.
purple_orca_tidecaller.book_lore: A salt-stained songbook; each shanty is also a spell, if you hold the right note.

quicksilver_rush.name: Quicksilver
quicksilver_rush.desc: Time seems to wade through syrup around you. Dashes, afterimages and a blur of cuts for the hunter who is simply never where the blow lands.
quicksilver_rush.book_lore: Haste is a skill. Patience is what you do with the time it buys.

raid_captain_command.name: Raid Captain's Command
raid_captain_command.desc: Lead the clear: call targets, draw the boss's eye, rally the party and strike where the plan says to. A support line built on marks, taunts and auras.
raid_captain_command.book_lore: The plan survives until first contact. The captain does not.

rea_laevateinn.name: Rea Laevateinn
rea_laevateinn.book_name: Long Chant of the Flame Sword
rea_laevateinn.desc: Elven chant magic of fire: stand still, speak the verses and loose a flame sword of terrible reach. Slow to begin, hard to forget.
rea_laevateinn.book_lore: Every verse is a step toward a fire you may not like.

realmheart_physique.name: Realmheart Physique
realmheart_physique.desc: Mana woven into every cell of the body, so the flesh itself is a spell. A defender's line: skin that turns edges, wounds that close mid-fight, and a counter for those who dare to strike.
realmheart_physique.book_lore: The heart sees the realm, and the realm answers.

regressor_hundred_lives.name: Regressor's Hundred Lives
regressor_hundred_lives.desc: The weight of a hundred failed lives, remembered. You have seen every blow before, and you fight like someone who has already lost and learned.
regressor_hundred_lives.book_lore: Death is only the turn of a page, and he remembers every page.

rukh_caller_priest.name: Rukh Caller Priest
rukh_caller_priest.desc: A priest of the white birds that drift above the world: call them close and they bring light, healing and a warm certainty. A line that mends friends and blesses the dawn.
rukh_caller_priest.book_lore: A hymnal of the white birds' flight paths, strangely warm to the touch.

rulers_authority.name: Ruler's Authority
rulers_authority.desc: Invisible hands of force bend the world to your will: hurl, lift and crush from across the room without touching a thing.
rulers_authority.book_lore: Not a spell. A command the air has agreed to obey.

ryuu_astrea_blade.name: Astraea's Wooden Sword
ryuu_astrea_blade.book_name: Ledger of the Last Astraea Blade
ryuu_astrea_blade.desc: The elf blade dancer's justice: a wooden sword that parries and strikes back, a clean dash, a charged aria and a debt of justice that waits to be paid. Evolves after four hundred arts of this skill.
ryuu_astrea_blade.book_lore: Justice is not a feeling. It is a debt, and she has never once defaulted.

sangah_war_room.name: Yoo Sangah's War Room
sangah_war_room.desc: Plans, formations and a notebook for every contingency. She does not need to hit hard; she needs everyone else to.
sangah_war_room.book_lore: Victory is a schedule, and she keeps it better than anyone.

save_point_anchor.name: Save Point Anchor
save_point_anchor.desc: Plant a save point: a warm anchor that heals him, his allies and eventually pulls him back from a fatal blow. He fights as if death were a menu option.
save_point_anchor.book_lore: He always died near the last checkpoint. The checkpoint always remembered.

scenario_clearer.name: Scenario Clearer
scenario_clearer.desc: Every scenario has a clear condition, a time limit and a reward. You are the one who always meets the first and beats the second.
scenario_clearer.book_lore: Clear conditions are never kind, but they are always written down somewhere.

scythe_reaper.name: Scythe's Reaping Style
scythe_reaper.desc: The long blade of the Alacryan elite: wide arcs, soul reaping and a single closing cut. A fighter who gets stronger and steadier with every foe that falls.
scythe_reaper.book_lore: A good harvest leaves nothing standing.

sea_of_stories.name: Sea of Stories
sea_of_stories.desc: The great sea where every unread tale ends up. Call the tide to heal, drag and crush; its water remembers everything it has ever carried.
sea_of_stories.book_lore: Every story that is forgotten sinks, and the sea keeps all of them.

secretive_plotter.name: Secretive Plotter
secretive_plotter.desc: A constellation who hides behind a hundred plans. Smoke, ambush, traps and one last move laid out three chapters ago.
secretive_plotter.book_lore: Nobody sees the plotter. They only see how neatly everything turned out.

sequence_break_route.name: Sequence Break Route
sequence_break_route.book_name: Route Map of the Skipped Chapter
sequence_break_route.desc: Skip the intended path: leap over the gate, jump the pit, cross the map in a straight line. A traveler's kit of long jumps, teleports and cheap tricks for the one who hates waiting.
sequence_break_route.book_lore: The game says walk. He says watch this.

seven_seas_swordmaster.name: Seven Seas Swordmaster
seven_seas_swordmaster.desc: A swordsman with a sailor's footing and a king's confidence: clean cuts, quick feet and one trick no one saw coming. Duel for fun, finish for keeps.
seven_seas_swordmaster.book_lore: A swordmaster's pocket guide, damp at the corners and annotated in a flamboyant hand.

shadow_djinn_assassin.name: Shadow Djinn Assassin
shadow_djinn_assassin.desc: A Djinn of dusk lends you its silence: you appear behind the target, strike for the throat and take your leave in a puff of black smoke. Nobody has seen you work.
shadow_djinn_assassin.book_lore: Written in ink that fades unless you read it in the dark.

shadow_exchange.name: Shadow Exchange
shadow_exchange.desc: Trade places with a shadow soldier and appear wherever your shades stand. A line of teleports, ambush strikes and vanishing acts.
shadow_exchange.book_lore: Where your shadow stands, you may already be.

shadow_extraction.name: Arise: Shadow Extraction
shadow_extraction.desc: The Shadow Monarch's first gift: rip the shades of the fallen out of the dark and make their strength your own. A necromancer's line of drain, fear and harvested souls.
shadow_extraction.book_lore: Every grave is a recruiting office, and the dead never say no.

shadow_ninja_souei.name: Souei's Shadow Step
shadow_ninja_souei.desc: A spymaster's craft: appear from the floor, leave no trace and leave a few blades behind. Quiet kills and quiet escapes.
shadow_ninja_souei.book_lore: No one ever saw the report being filed.

shield_throw_art.name: Shield Throw Art
shield_throw_art.book_name: Training Pamphlet of the Returning Disc
shield_throw_art.desc: A shield is also a projectile. Hurl it and it ricochets between foes, hauls the lot of them back with a chain, and returns to your arm to the sound of a bell.
shield_throw_art.book_lore: It always comes back, and it brings company.

shuna_holy_weaving.name: Shuna's Holy Weaving
shuna_holy_weaving.book_name: Pattern Book of the Princess's Loom
shuna_holy_weaving.desc: A princess who mends what the war breaks: cloth woven with prayer, light that purges the unholy and a loom that never stops working for the people behind her.
shuna_holy_weaving.book_lore: Every stitch was a small promise.

siege_calculation.name: Siege Calculation
siege_calculation.book_name: Ballistics Table of the Patient Battery
siege_calculation.desc: Dig in, measure the angle and let the stones do the work. A knight who fights like an artillery crew: mark the target, rain boulders on it, and stay out of reach.
siege_calculation.book_lore: Distance is a tool. He spent a lot of time measuring it.

silver_eagle_marksman.name: Silver Eagle Marksman
silver_eagle_marksman.desc: A long-range hunter of the sky: stand still, breathe out and let a silver-bright bolt cross half the field. Mobile enough to relocate before they find you.
silver_eagle_marksman.book_lore: A marksman's journal, every page ruled with wind-speed estimates.

slime_body_shapeshift.name: Slime Body Shapeshift
slime_body_shapeshift.desc: A body with no fixed shape: it splits, stretches, bounces and re-forms. Hits slide off it, wounds seal themselves, and anything that touches it may be absorbed.
slime_body_shapeshift.book_lore: It was not a shield. It was just where he was not.

smoldering_fang_of_insanity.name: Smoldering Fang of Insanity
smoldering_fang_of_insanity.desc: A cursed fang of The Exiled Heavy Knight, nothing to do with dragons or their fire: a berserker's skill of withering bites, ash that chokes whoever strikes you, a howl that breaks the nerve of a crowd and a fit of insanity that trades your guard for strength.
smoldering_fang_of_insanity.book_lore: A cracked yellow fang bound into a charred cover. The pages smell of smoke, and the margins are written by someone who stopped being afraid.

solomon_wisdom_sage.name: Solomon's Wisdom Sage
solomon_wisdom_sage.desc: An echo of the first king's gift: protective, patient and oddly cheerful. Wisdom turns into shields, shields into light and light into a blessing you hand to everyone nearby.
solomon_wisdom_sage.book_lore: Plain words about kindness, written in the margins of a very old map.

spade_beastblood_hunter.name: Spade Beastblood Hunter
spade_beastblood_hunter.desc: A hunter whose blood has a little of the wild in it: lunge, claw and drop from above. You deal best against monsters and beasts, and you smell the kill before it happens.
spade_beastblood_hunter.book_lore: Tally marks, claw rubbings and a note that reads: 'it can smell fear, so do not'.

spatial_manipulation.name: Spatial Manipulation
spatial_manipulation.desc: Fold the room: walk between two points, cut the air along a line and pull a foe through a rift. The mind does the geometry, the body only moves where it is sent.
spatial_manipulation.book_lore: The distance between them was only a suggestion.

spirit_dive_rider.name: Spirit Dive Rider
spirit_dive_rider.desc: Dive into the body of an elemental spirit and fight in its shape: wings of wind, claws of stone, a frame of fire and water. Four spirits, one body.
spirit_dive_rider.book_lore: A codex where each chapter was dictated by a different spirit and you can tell.

stealth_skill.name: Skill: Stealth
stealth_skill.desc: Hide your presence from monsters and hunters alike: dissolve into the dark, relocate silently and strike where the guard is thinnest.
stealth_skill.book_lore: Be the part of the dungeon nobody remembers seeing.

steel_bulwark.name: Hyunsung's Steel Bulwark
steel_bulwark.desc: The party's wall. Plant your feet, draw the enemy onto yourself and become the one thing nothing gets past.
steel_bulwark.book_lore: He never asked to be a hero; he just refused to step aside.

stigma_bearer.name: Stigma Bearer
stigma_bearer.desc: A brand burned into the skin that grows hungrier the closer you come to dying. Bleed for it, and it pays you back in strength and borrowed life.
stigma_bearer.book_lore: The mark was not a gift; it was an invoice, and he has paid it every day since.

stone_djinn_bulwark.name: Stone Djinn Bulwark
stone_djinn_bulwark.desc: Stand on the earth and the earth stands with you: a Djinn's stone plate, a crushing fist and a patience older than the mountain. You decide where the fight happens.
stone_djinn_bulwark.book_lore: A heavy volume bound in slate, which makes it hard to read in a hurry.

storm_dragon_veldora.name: Storm Dragon Veldora's Might
storm_dragon_veldora.desc: The Storm Dragon's raw presence: thunderclouds, a pressure that makes lesser monsters shake, and a breath that tears the horizon open. Everything is overwhelming and nothing is subtle.
storm_dragon_veldora.book_lore: The storm waited three hundred years. It did not wait quietly.

storm_wolf_ranga.name: Ranga, the Storm Wolf
storm_wolf_ranga.book_name: Pack Song of the Storm Wolf
storm_wolf_ranga.desc: A black wolf who grew into a storm: running with a thunderstorm in his shadow, lightning racing along the fangs and a howl that makes the pack follow.
storm_wolf_ranga.book_lore: Where the thunder runs, he is running too.

storyteller.name: Storyteller
storyteller.desc: Words become weapons when the right person tells them. Weave a tale and the scenario bends: bolts of text, healing lullabies and a plot twist from the sky.
storyteller.book_lore: A story is only alive while someone is telling it, and you never stop.

sword_saint_style.name: Sword Saint's Style
sword_saint_style.desc: A purist's sword: no flourish, no waste. Parry, rise, flow from cut to cut and finish with one clean line. A weapon art about timing rather than power.
sword_saint_style.book_lore: One sword. One breath. One answer.

system_daily_quest.name: The System: Daily Quest
system_daily_quest.desc: Obey the System's blue windows: boosts for each quest accepted, level-up pulses, analysis of every enemy and the grim bargain of the Penalty Zone.

takemikazuchi_bushi.name: Takemikazuchi Bushi
takemikazuchi_bushi.book_name: Dojo Scroll of the Thunder God
takemikazuchi_bushi.desc: Eastern swordsmanship of the dojo-familia: drawn blades, one-cut kills and a calm that makes monsters hesitate. Inspired by the Japanese-style fighters of the story.
takemikazuchi_bushi.book_lore: The sheath is half the sword.

temple_delver.name: Temple Delver
temple_delver.desc: A dungeon crawler of the sunken temples: you read the walls, swipe the treasure and walk away before the ceiling does. Luck, loot and a very small body count.
temple_delver.book_lore: A weatherproof case of rubbings, floor plans and grease-pencil notes about which tiles lie.

thunder_art.name: Elemental Art: Thunderbolt
thunder_art.desc: Lightning as a mage's tool: stunning pulses, chained bolts and a dash too quick to see. Hard-hitting from range, jittery up close.
thunder_art.book_lore: Speed is just lightning that stopped to think.

thunder_djinn_duelist.name: Thunder Djinn Duelist
thunder_djinn_duelist.desc: A lightning Djinn's speed in your muscles: blink in, strike, blink out and be across the field before the thunder arrives. Blows that jump from one foe to the next.
thunder_djinn_duelist.book_lore: A short manual full of arrows pointing at where you used to be.

tide_djinn_dancer.name: Tide Djinn Dancer
tide_djinn_dancer.desc: Water winds around you like a ribbon: flowing, quick and kind. Heal with the tide, drive off the enemy with a lash of water and never stay where the blow lands.
tide_djinn_dancer.book_lore: A ribbon-bound pamphlet of steps, pivots and the curve of a falling wave.

tog_agnis_ice.name: Agnis Ice Crystals
tog_agnis_ice.book_name: Crystal Primer of the Cold Line
tog_agnis_ice.desc: Cold Shinsu of a Great Family's heir: hard crystals of ice grown from the hand. Volleys of shards, glacier waves and a mirror-bright wall for protection.
tog_agnis_ice.book_lore: Every page is a thin sheet of ice. The ink is meltwater.

tog_anak_zahard.name: Anak Zahard
tog_anak_zahard.desc: Anak Zahard, a half-Princess of Zahard climbing the Tower for revenge: Shinsu-strengthened legs that cover the field in a blink and the Green April, a hook that stretches, whips and splits when it is ignited. What she hooks, she keeps.
tog_anak_zahard.book_lore: A diluted bloodline, a stolen name and one very long hook. The Tower has been warned.

tog_beast_tamer.name: Floor Beast Rider
tog_beast_tamer.desc: Some climbers ride the Tower's beasts instead of fighting them. Pounces, charges and a howl that rallies the pack; you fight with a beast's weight and instinct.
tog_beast_tamer.book_lore: Fifty beasts, forty-nine of them hungry, one of them yours.

tog_black_march.name: Black March
tog_black_march.desc: A black blade that drinks in the light around it. Long dark cuts, shadow rushes and a thirst that gets worse the longer the fight goes.
tog_black_march.book_lore: The blade writes in the dark, and the ink is a color nobody has named.

tog_faerie.name: Faerie
tog_faerie.book_name: A Faerie's Little Book of Tricks
tog_faerie.desc: A Faerie is a small, bright, quick being of the Tower, half dream and half mischief. It drifts, blinks, tangles and lulls, and leaves glitter wherever it goes.
tog_faerie.book_lore: Written on a petal and not meant to be read in one sitting.

tog_fisherman.name: Fisherman
tog_fisherman.book_name: The Angler's Ledger of the Tower
tog_fisherman.desc: The Fisherman Position casts glowing Shinsu lines and hooks to catch prey twice its size. You hook, mark and reel in whatever swims too close.
tog_fisherman.book_lore: Every hook in it is tied to a name and a number of lost sleeves.

tog_floor_guard.name: Floor Guard
tog_floor_guard.desc: A Floor Guard stands at a staircase and lets nothing pass. Heavy, loud, and very hard to get around: you hold the line for everyone behind you.
tog_floor_guard.book_lore: The first order is: you do not leave your post. There is no second order.

tog_fug_assassin.name: FUG Hunter
tog_fug_assassin.desc: An organised killer of the shadows: fang-thin blades, poisoned darts and a smoke bomb, made for ending a fight before it starts. Pick a mark and finish it.
tog_fug_assassin.book_lore: Each page lists a name, a price and a crossed-out line.

tog_guide.name: Guide
tog_guide.desc: A Guide leads a team of climbers up the Tower: finds the route, keeps everyone fast and fed, and knows exactly where the beast is weak.
tog_guide.book_lore: Half of it is a map of the Tower, the other half is who was supposed to be on it.

tog_headon_channel.name: Headon Channeler
tog_headon_channel.desc: A Channeler hangs a Shinsu-conducting Headon crystal on the body and pours charge through it. Arcs of lightning, cannon beams and a crystal that sings when it is full.
tog_headon_channel.book_lore: Do not stand near the owner when the crystal is humming.

tog_inventory.name: Inventory
tog_inventory.desc: The Inventory Position keeps a pocket of folded space and pulls weapons, supplies and surprises out of it. Blink, volley, and drop what you have stored on your enemies.
tog_inventory.book_lore: Item 1: this book. Item 2: the pocket it is in. Item 3 is the problem.

tog_irregular.name: Irregular
tog_irregular.desc: An Irregular enters the Tower through a door that was never opened for anyone, with a power nobody has measured. Wild leaps, sudden surges and a stubborn refusal to be explained.
tog_irregular.book_lore: The examiners put a question mark where the entry's rank should be.

tog_jahad_royal.name: Royal Blood of Jahad
tog_jahad_royal.desc: Crown-and-banner combat of the royal house: a straight sword, a commanding voice and a presence that makes soldiers fall in. Strong when at full strength.
tog_jahad_royal.book_lore: Every court has a speaker; this volume is the speaker's whisper.

tog_light_bearer.name: Light Bearer
