tog_light_bearer.desc: The Light Bearer carries a lamp of Shinsu through the dark floors: light that guides allies, mends them and burns the foes who fear it.
tog_light_bearer.book_lore: Wick trimmed, oil of Shinsu, one match; do not blink.

tog_lighthouse_keeper.name: Lighthouse Keeper
tog_lighthouse_keeper.desc: A keeper stands still on a tall stone and sweeps the dark with a beam. Long reach, loud warnings and a slow turning light nothing can hide from.
tog_lighthouse_keeper.book_lore: Entry after entry: all well. The last one reads: all well, and something is looking back.

tog_rak_wraithraiser.name: Rak Wraithraiser
tog_rak_wraithraiser.book_name: A Giant's Guide to Throwing Spears
tog_rak_wraithraiser.desc: Rak Wraithraiser, the loud and proud Spear Bearer of the Wraithraiser giants: spears thrown like thunderbolts, the Mad Shocker from the Workshop and a Compression Licenser's trick of shrinking to a handy size and growing back in the middle of a fight.
tog_rak_wraithraiser.book_lore: Page one, in huge letters: if you can hear him, you are already in range.

tog_ranker_authority.name: Ranker's Authority
tog_ranker_authority.desc: You have climbed beyond the floors where ordinary people stop. A Ranker's presence presses on the weak, and a single command can bring a hall to its knees.
tog_ranker_authority.book_lore: The first page lists the floors cleared; the last page lists the debts.

tog_regular_climber.name: Regular
tog_regular_climber.desc: A plain Regular, with no special blood and no special weapon, climbing on stubbornness. You survive what should have killed you and strike when it counts.
tog_regular_climber.book_lore: Scribbled in the margins: it is not about winning, it is about being still standing at the end.

tog_reverse_flow_control.name: Reverse Flow Control
tog_reverse_flow_control.desc: Instead of pushing Shinsu out, you read the flow of the Shinsu around you and turn it back on whoever sent it. Counters, pulls and borrowed force.
tog_reverse_flow_control.book_lore: The margin says: do not fight the current, hand it back.

tog_rose_shower.name: Rose Shower
tog_rose_shower.desc: Ha Yuri Zahard's Shinsu roses: a red-velvet blade of packed Shinsu, petals that gather into pillars and a rain that covers the whole field. Every wound she leaves blooms later.
tog_rose_shower.book_lore: The petals fall slowly. The people under them do not.
arts: Red Velvet Sword: Great Wave Blast

tog_scout.name: Scout
tog_scout.desc: The Scout Position is eyes, ears and knife: quick on the stairs, quiet in the halls, and hard to find once it has marked you.
tog_scout.book_lore: Three pages of maps and one line: never be where they look.

tog_shinsu_reinforcement.name: Shinsu Reinforcement
tog_shinsu_reinforcement.desc: Strengthen your body from the inside with Shinsu until fists, shoulders and skin are as hard as the Tower's floors. A wall that walks.
tog_shinsu_reinforcement.book_lore: Written by a Floor Guard who stopped counting the blows.

tog_shinsu_shooting.name: Shinsu Shooting
tog_shinsu_shooting.desc: The first thing every Regular learns: pack Shinsu into your hand and fire it. Beams, volleys and bursts of raw blue pressure.
tog_shinsu_shooting.book_lore: Page one says: breathe in the Tower, breathe out a bullet.

tog_spear_bearer.name: Spear Bearer
tog_spear_bearer.desc: The Spear Bearer Position fights at the end of a long shaft of Shinsu-infused metal. Straight thrusts, vaulting lunges and one killing point.
tog_spear_bearer.book_lore: Thrust is a sentence; the last lesson is the full stop.

tog_suspendium_arms.name: Suspendium Arms
tog_suspendium_arms.desc: Suspendium, the Tower's cold, weightless metal, forged into blades and hammers whose weight changes as you swing them. Heavy where it counts, light where it must be.
tog_suspendium_arms.book_lore: Every page is a different weight; the binding is a curse word.

tog_true_flame.name: True Flame
tog_true_flame.desc: Yeon Yihwa's Yeon-family fire: Hwayeomsa flames that are hard to aim and harder to calm, and beneath them the True Flame that guards her life. Fire that has burned you teaches you to keep it.
tog_true_flame.book_lore: Once a century the Yeon house bears a girl the fire does not refuse.

tog_wave_controller.name: Wave Controller
tog_wave_controller.desc: A Wave Controller bends Shinsu into waves and uses their rhythm as a weapon. Rolling shocks, resonance and the heavy crest of a great breaker.
tog_wave_controller.book_lore: The footnotes are all about timing; the main text is about not drowning.

tog_wolhaiguk_moon.name: Wolhaiguk Moon Arts
tog_wolhaiguk_moon.desc: Blade and tide techniques of the Moon-Sea house: thin crescents of light, pulling tides and a step that follows the moon. Strongest when the sky is dark.
tog_wolhaiguk_moon.book_lore: Each page is dated by the phase of the moon it was written under.

tog_zahard_decree.name: Zahard's Decree
tog_zahard_decree.book_name: The Statute Scroll of the Tower
tog_zahard_decree.desc: The Tower runs on the King's law, and you carry a scrap of it. Pass sentence on foes, turn blows back by law, and bring a room to order.
tog_zahard_decree.book_lore: Seventeen articles; the eighteenth is erased and everyone knows what it said.

tundra_harpoon_hunter.name: Tundra Harpoon Hunter
tundra_harpoon_hunter.desc: A northern hunter who has made a friend of the cold: harpoon, whiteout and a quiet certainty about where the whale will surface. Patient, tough and fond of a long pull.
tundra_harpoon_hunter.book_lore: Oral tradition set down in pictures: a figure, a hook and a very large animal.

tyrant_dark_mirror.name: Tyrant's Dark Mirror
tyrant_dark_mirror.desc: The author who writes the world knows how to turn it round. Mirrors repeat strikes, bounce pain back and trap foes in their own reflections.
tyrant_dark_mirror.book_lore: Nobody writes villains as well as someone who has been one in every draft.

vampire_queen_night.name: Vampire Queen of the Night
vampire_queen_night.book_name: Night Court of the Vampire Queen
vampire_queen_night.desc: The queen of the night walks in her own dark: stronger the longer the sun is gone, with a bite that feeds her and a stare that holds her prey in place.
vampire_queen_night.book_lore: She is only ever late for the morning.

velzard_frost_dragon.name: Velzard's Frost Dragon
velzard_frost_dragon.book_name: Winter Annals of the Ice Dragon
velzard_frost_dragon.desc: The ice dragon's cold, patient fury: frost that settles gently and then stays. Every move leaves the air colder, and the foe a little slower.
velzard_frost_dragon.book_lore: The snow fell softly. It was still the worst thing in the room.

vritra_blood_rite.name: Vritra Blood Rite
vritra_blood_rite.desc: The bloodline of a ruling Asura clan, unleashed. A predatory line of drains, hooks and burning blood; it does better the more it spills.
vritra_blood_rite.book_lore: Power is borrowed from the blood. Return it with interest.

wall_clip_glitch.name: Wall-Clip Glitch
wall_clip_glitch.desc: Slip into the seam between two blocks where the game's rules fail: the enemy cannot see you, you cannot be reached, and the ground itself fights for you.
wall_clip_glitch.book_lore: He walked into the wall. The wall let him through.

way_of_the_wind.name: Way of the Wind
way_of_the_wind.desc: A swordsman's road that follows the breeze. Never stand still: dash, spin and fall on the enemy like a gale with a blade.
way_of_the_wind.book_lore: The wind has no sheath, and it answers anyone who walks fast enough.

wendy_sky_dragon.name: Sky Dragon Slayer
wendy_sky_dragon.book_name: Primer of the Sky Dragon Slayer
wendy_sky_dragon.desc: Wendy Marvell's Sky Dragon Slayer magic: healing breath, and the Troia, Vernier, Arms and Armor enchantments that make a whole party faster, stronger and tougher. Her blows are gentle but patient, and her Debt is wind that waits, until the Shattering Light brings it all down.
wendy_sky_dragon.book_lore: Grandeeney taught her that the sky is no weapon: it holds the wounded up, until the day it must hold the enemy down.

werewolf_gale_kick.name: Werewolf's Gale Kick
werewolf_gale_kick.desc: A beast-person kicker in magic boots: charging, flipping, ricocheting kicks and a howl that rattles the nerves. Fast, rude and hard to pin down.
werewolf_gale_kick.book_lore: The boots do half the talking. The other half is the kick.

white_flame_sovereign.name: Sovereign of White Flames
white_flame_sovereign.desc: A fire that burns hotter than red and cleans what it touches: needles of white flame, purging warmth for friends and a core that does not scorch you.
white_flame_sovereign.book_lore: Not all fire destroys. This one only decides.

white_tiger_baek.name: Tiger's Claws
white_tiger_baek.book_name: Field Notes of the White Tiger
white_tiger_baek.desc: Baek Yoonho's way of fighting: the White Tiger Guild master turns hands and body into those of a great white beast, reads his prey with the Eyes of the Beast and grows fiercest when the next blow could end him.
white_tiger_baek.book_lore: The first rule of the guild: when the claws come out, the allies step back.

wizard_king_sovereign.name: Wizard King Sovereign
wizard_king_sovereign.desc: The one who leads the whole kingdom's knights: rally the line, hold the field with composure and drop a royal decree when the moment is ripe. Power as a duty.
wizard_king_sovereign.book_lore: Stiff vellum with a seal, written for people who command magic knights for a living.

wynn_fimbulvetr.name: Wynn Fimbulvetr
wynn_fimbulvetr.desc: Elven chant magic of ice: the long winter arrives on cue. Freezing breath, a pull toward the cold and slow, crushing control of the room.
wynn_fimbulvetr.book_lore: Fimbulvetr: three winters with no summer between. Speak it carefully.
